project.name: insight-ddi-checker
project.description: Standalone drug-drug interaction checker module with versioned knowledge-base ingestion and audit support.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Controls which project paths the Understand analyzer excludes from codebase discovery and graph generation.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Stores the Understand analyzer output-language preference for this project.

nodes.name: active-kb.js
nodes.summary: Generated browser-ready JavaScript artifact containing the active drug-interaction knowledge base for direct loading by the dashboard.

nodes.name: active-kb.json
nodes.summary: Canonical active knowledge-base dataset containing normalized drugs, interaction evidence, reports, clinical-use metadata, and audit schema.
nodes.languageNotes: The top-level JSON separates drug identities, pairwise interactions, source reports, normalization metadata, and audit requirements.

nodes.name: ingest.mjs
nodes.summary: Ingests source drug reports, normalizes drug identities and dose hints, extracts interaction records, and builds versioned browser and JSON knowledge-base artifacts.

nodes.name: validate-kb.mjs
nodes.summary: Validates required interaction fields, severity values, drug references, and self-interaction constraints in an active knowledge-base JSON file.

nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Coordinates the browser dashboard, local knowledge-base revisions, medication entry, interaction checks, clinical review workflows, report upload, audit history, and exports.
nodes.languageNotes: An IIFE encapsulates browser state and binds the dashboard directly to DOM elements and the global DDI engine.

nodes.name: ddi-engine.js
nodes.summary: Provides the environment-neutral drug-interaction engine for report parsing, knowledge-base indexing, drug suggestion and resolution, pair checking, severity ordering, and audit entry creation.
nodes.languageNotes: A UMD-style wrapper exposes the same factory result through CommonJS or the browser global DDIEngine.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Defines the responsive visual system for the medication checker dashboard, alerts, review panels, forms, navigation, and administrative views.

nodes.name: ddi-engine.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Exercises the drug-interaction engine's normalization, parsing, suggestions, interaction detection, severity behavior, and audit output.

nodes.name: ingest.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Tests report-ingestion helpers and knowledge-base construction against representative drug and interaction text.

nodes.name: ui-source.test.mjs
nodes.summary: Performs source-level UI assertions for administrative controls, session/result exports, and safe evidence rendering.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts arbitrary labels into stable lowercase underscore-separated identifiers.

nodes.name: cleanLine
nodes.summary: Removes citation markers, bullet prefixes, and excess whitespace from imported report lines.

nodes.name: isNoiseLine
nodes.summary: Recognizes navigation, timestamp, URL, and interaction-checker boilerplate that should be excluded from report parsing.

nodes.name: normalizeDrugName
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes drug names by removing product qualifiers and normalizing punctuation and whitespace.

nodes.name: getOrCreateDrug
nodes.summary: Resolves a normalized drug identity in the ingestion map or creates a pending identity while preserving useful aliases.

nodes.name: addDoseSuggestions
nodes.summary: Merges cleaned, unique dose suggestions into a drug record with a bounded result size.

nodes.name: extractDoseSuggestions
nodes.summary: Extracts plausible dosing statements from report text using units, dosage-form, route, and frequency heuristics.

nodes.name: readTextFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively discovers supported source text files while recording paths skipped by extension filtering.

nodes.name: parseDrugHeader
nodes.summary: Infers the primary drug name and aliases from cleaned report headings and the source filename.

nodes.name: collectInteractionSections
nodes.summary: Collects report text under recognized severity headings while stopping at unrelated clinical sections.

nodes.name: splitBlocks
nodes.summary: Segments interaction-section lines into logical records using blanks, bullets, headings, and continuation rules.

nodes.name: looksLikeDrugHeading
nodes.summary: Classifies short report lines that resemble drug-name headings rather than narrative content.

nodes.name: parseBulletRecord
nodes.summary: Parses a structured bullet block into interacting-drug and narrative fields when its syntax is sufficiently complete.

nodes.name: inferMechanism
nodes.summary: Infers a concise pharmacologic interaction mechanism from characteristic phrases in source evidence.

nodes.name: inferRecommendation
nodes.summary: Derives a clinical handling recommendation from interaction severity and narrative cues.

nodes.name: inferMonitoring
nodes.summary: Builds monitoring guidance from evidence mentioning ECG, bleeding, laboratory, sedation, or vital-sign risks.

nodes.name: createInteraction
nodes.summary: Constructs a normalized interaction record with evidence provenance, review state, and knowledge-base version metadata.

nodes.name: parseReport
nodes.summary: Orchestrates complete report parsing by resolving drugs, extracting severity sections and dose hints, and emitting interaction and report records.

nodes.name: buildKnowledgeBase
nodes.summary: Reads all source reports, merges drug and interaction records, deduplicates pairs, and assembles the versioned active knowledge-base document.

layers.name: Project Analysis Configuration
layers.description: Local Understand settings and ignore rules control how this drug-interaction module is analyzed and documented.

layers.name: Knowledge Base Data
layers.description: Canonical JSON and browser-ready JavaScript artifacts hold the active versioned drug-interaction knowledge base.

layers.name: Ingestion and Validation
layers.description: Command-line tooling parses source reports, builds knowledge-base revisions, and validates clinical interaction data integrity.

layers.name: Clinical Application
layers.description: The browser controller, deterministic interaction engine, and responsive stylesheet deliver medication checking, review, audit, and administration workflows.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Node-based tests verify the interaction engine, ingestion pipeline, and safety-critical UI source behavior.

tour.title: Clinical Application Entry
tour.description: Start with the browser controller to see the project as a complete medication-safety workflow. It connects medication entry, interaction checking, clinical review, uploads, audit history, and exports, providing the broad runtime map for every later stop.

tour.title: Interaction Engine
tour.description: The environment-neutral engine supplies the deterministic behavior behind the dashboard: it indexes the knowledge base, resolves drug names, checks medication pairs, orders severity, and creates audit entries. Separating this logic from the browser controller makes the safety-critical rules easier to reuse and test.

tour.title: Knowledge Base Contract
tour.description: The canonical JSON dataset is the durable contract consumed by the engine, containing normalized drugs, evidence-backed interactions, clinical metadata, report provenance, and audit schema. Its generated JavaScript counterpart makes the same active version directly loadable by the browser application introduced in Step 1.
tour.languageLesson: Keeping canonical JSON separate from a generated browser wrapper preserves a tool-friendly source of truth while supporting direct script loading in a static application.

tour.title: Report Ingestion Pipeline
tour.description: The ingestion command transforms heterogeneous source reports into the knowledge-base contract from Step 3. Its high fan-out reflects a staged pipeline that cleans text, normalizes identities, extracts dosing and severity evidence, constructs interaction records, and assembles a versioned dataset.

tour.title: Knowledge Base Validation
tour.description: After ingestion, the validation command guards the boundary between generated data and the clinical application. It checks required fields, allowed severity values, valid drug references, and self-interaction constraints before a knowledge-base revision is treated as active.

tour.title: Safety Test Suite
tour.description: The tests verify the architecture at its three highest-risk seams: deterministic engine behavior, report-to-knowledge-base construction, and safe UI capabilities. Read them after the implementation layers to see the concrete invariants maintained across parsing, severity handling, evidence rendering, administrative controls, and exports.

tour.title: Responsive Presentation
tour.description: Finish with the stylesheet that turns the workflows from Step 1 into a responsive clinical dashboard. Its rules cover alerts, forms, review panels, navigation, and administrative views, showing how interaction severity and workflow state are communicated visually to users.
